Rules:
- Use only the tables of the schema, without a schema prefix.
- Timestamps are UTC.
- Never filter tokens or entities by symbol or name; use the addresses the evidence gives.
- Use standard SQL: no QUALIFY, no EXCLUDE, no list functions.
- Reply with the query in a ```sql code block and nothing else.

### Schema
-- Every Ethereum block of September 2026 (UTC).
CREATE TABLE blocks (
  number BIGINT,  -- The block number. Examples: '25878705', '25878706'
  hash VARCHAR,  -- Hash of the block. Examples: '0x00001c07aa548d99ad62575d24d38c8bc7ba9adfafbbac257403d5adf1ec17b0', '0x000042d61d5eda637a98ab9dd910e769a594a742b9563b7383ca2f585f019939'
  parent_hash VARCHAR,  -- Hash of the parent block. Examples: '0x00001c07aa548d99ad62575d24d38c8bc7ba9adfafbbac257403d5adf1ec17b0', '0x000042d61d5eda637a98ab9dd910e769a594a742b9563b7383ca2f585f019939'
  timestamp TIMESTAMP,  -- The timestamp for when the block was collated. Examples: '2026-09-01 00:00:11', '2026-09-01 00:00:23'
  miner VARCHAR,  -- The address of the beneficiary to whom the mining rewards were given. Examples: '0x4838b106fce9647bdf1e7877bf73ce8b0bad5f97', '0x396343362be2a4da1ce0c1c210945346fb82aa49'
  size BIGINT,  -- The size of this block in bytes. Examples: '1205', '148798'
  gas_limit BIGINT,  -- The maximum gas allowed in this block. Examples: '60000000', '59941408'
  gas_used BIGINT,  -- The total used gas by all transactions in this block. Examples: '0', '26185301'
  transaction_count BIGINT,  -- The number of transactions in the block. Examples: '227', '224'
  base_fee_per_gas BIGINT,  -- Protocol base fee per gas, which can move up or down. Examples: '49045353', '63138320'
  blob_gas_used BIGINT,  -- The total amount of blob gas consumed by transactions in the block. Examples: '0', '393216'
  excess_blob_gas BIGINT  -- A running total of blob gas consumed in excess of the target, prior to the block. This is used to set blob gas pricing. Examples: '178553567', '184505771'
);

-- Every transaction of September 2026 (UTC), with its receipt.
CREATE TABLE transactions (
  hash VARCHAR,  -- Hash of the transaction. Examples: '0x00001ee0b8390730c24261f11da8c2b69aed837308f50c1d0c1f5dfbc3e0b569', '0x00007182a94e5e974b69bcdc0b36b6daa2205699021d3ca5157bc6baad8aaa00'
  nonce BIGINT,  -- The number of transactions made by the sender prior to this one. Examples: '0', '1'
  transaction_index BIGINT,  -- Integer of the transactions index position in the block. Examples: '0', '1'
  from_address VARCHAR,  -- Address of the sender. Examples: '0x9430801ebaf509ad49202aabc5f5bc6fd8a3daf8', '0x8393153f2bf8b2ae0c9f04d5910a4e358a74e404'
  to_address VARCHAR,  -- Address of the receiver. null when its a contract creation transaction. Examples: '0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7', '0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48'

  gas BIGINT,  -- Gas provided by the sender. Examples: '21000', '55470'
  gas_price BIGINT,  -- Gas price provided by the sender in Wei. Examples: '125000000', '80000000'
  max_fee_per_gas BIGINT,  -- Total fee that covers both base and priority fees. Examples: '2000000000', '80000000'
  max_priority_fee_per_gas BIGINT,  -- Fee given to miners to incentivize them to include the transaction. Examples: '200000000', '2000000000'
  transaction_type BIGINT,  -- Transaction type. Examples: '2', '0'
  receipt_status BIGINT,  -- Either 1 (success) or 0 (failure) (post Byzantium). Examples: '1', '0'
  receipt_gas_used BIGINT,  -- The amount of gas used by this specific transaction alone. Examples: '21000', '41309'
  receipt_cumulative_gas_used BIGINT,  -- The total amount of gas used when this transaction was executed in the block. Examples: '21000', '42000'
  receipt_effective_gas_price BIGINT,  -- The actual value per gas deducted from the senders account. Replacement of gas_price after EIP-1559. Examples: '125000000', '80000000'
  receipt_contract_address VARCHAR,  -- The contract address created, if the transaction was a contract creation, otherwise null. Examples: '0x00ab09a1db4b8e3e420f0c9fc6b1e8ff02585385', '0x00e8c4b21fd80d2abc8fc33f14f003102ea56717'
  max_fee_per_blob_gas BIGINT,  -- The maximum fee a user is willing to pay per blob gas. Examples: '1000000000', '1650000000'
  receipt_blob_gas_price BIGINT,  -- Blob gas price. Examples: '4286447', '2549026'
  receipt_blob_gas_used BIGINT,  -- Blob gas used. Examples: '393216', '131072'
  blob_count BIGINT,  -- Number of blob versioned hashes of the transaction (length of BigQuery's blob_versioned_hashes). Examples: '0', '3'
  block_number BIGINT,  -- Block number where this transaction was in. Examples: '25879306', '25879019'

  block_timestamp TIMESTAMP  -- Timestamp of the block where this transfer was in. Examples: '2026-09-01 01:13:59', '2026-09-01 01:18:47'
);

  address VARCHAR,  -- Address of the contract. Examples: '0x60bdee2ee93d117cbf1260fb50adaf906ef15778', '0x747d2c5ead32441946b6e2e3bf971c065ab32904'
  is_erc20 BOOLEAN,  -- Whether this contract is an ERC20 contract. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  is_erc721 BOOLEAN,  -- Whether this contract is an ERC721 contract. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  block_number BIGINT,  -- Block number where this contract was created. Examples: '22027705', '22027709'
  block_timestamp TIMESTAMP  -- Timestamp of the block where this contract was created. Examples: '2025-03-12 02:08:59', '2025-03-12 02:09:47'
);

-- Metadata of every token with a transfer in September 2026, as of the extraction (tokens_latest).
CREATE TABLE tokens (
  address VARCHAR,  -- The token contract address. Examples: '0x000000000000003607fce1ac9e043a86675c5c2f', '0x000000000000012def132e61759048be5b5c6033'
  symbol VARCHAR,  -- The symbol the contract reported when last probed. Examples: 'UNI-V2', 'USDT'
  name VARCHAR,  -- The name the contract reported when last probed. Examples: 'Uniswap V2', 'Tether USD'
  decimals VARCHAR,  -- Decimals as reported, as a string. Use safe_cast for casting to NUMERIC or FLOAT64. Examples: '18', '9'
  decimals_int BIGINT,  -- Decimals as an integer where the reported value is a sane decimal, else NULL. Examples: '18', '9'
  total_supply VARCHAR,  -- The freshest known total supply: the latest reading when it is at least as recent as the metadata probe, else the probe's own value. NULL by design for pure ERC-1155 contracts. Examples: '1000000000000000000000000000', '1000000000000000000'
  token_standard VARCHAR,  -- The most specific standard the contract satisfies: ERC1155, ERC721 or ERC20. Examples: 'ERC20', 'ERC721'
  token_standards VARCHAR,  -- Token standards the contract implements, joined with '|' (an ARRAY in BigQuery). Examples: 'ERC20', 'ERC721'
  protocols VARCHAR,  -- Protocols the token supports, joined with '|' (an ARRAY in BigQuery). Examples: 'erc20', 'erc721'
  is_erc20 BOOLEAN,  -- The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-20 selector predicate. Examples: 'true', 'false'
  is_erc721 BOOLEAN,  -- The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-721 selector predicate. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  is_erc1155 BOOLEAN,  -- The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-1155 selector predicate. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  implementation_address VARCHAR,  -- For proxies, the implementation the contract delegates to. Examples: '0x09a26fc8fcef18192e267d7a6da9dfb4be81dd6a', '0x8b72b9b8e544f944cdcdf0cdb6194f917ac1eba5'
  proxy_standard VARCHAR,  -- How implementation_address was determined: eip1167 or eip1967. Examples: 'eip1167', 'eip1967'
  creator_address VARCHAR,  -- The address that deployed the contract. Examples: '0x5c69bee701ef814a2b6a3edd4b1652cb9cc5aa6f', '0xc6b080ded03c3382476a76345e79f82bd480977b'
  creation_transaction_hash VARCHAR,  -- Hash of the transaction that deployed the contract. Examples: '0xff15954e76ad89528ce3b4d6350bddd9066dbde9f76b597e677b6e1e545d877d', '0xcd8db43e7e923007d0ff2b666560b6fc538aa9d4d9b372bd50bb15f9accf9985'
  block_number BIGINT,  -- Block number where this token was created. Examples: '25972783', '25972656'
  block_timestamp TIMESTAMP  -- Timestamp of the block where this token was created. Examples: '2026-09-14 02:44:59', '2026-09-14 02:19:35'
);

-- Hand-corrected symbol, name and decimals of tokens.
CREATE TABLE amended_tokens (
  address VARCHAR,  -- Lowercase token contract address. Examples: '0x000000000000003607fce1ac9e043a86675c5c2f', '0x000000000000012def132e61759048be5b5c6033'
  symbol VARCHAR,  -- Amended symbol: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value. Examples: 'UNI-V2', 'USDT'
  name VARCHAR,  -- Amended name: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value. Examples: 'Uniswap V2', 'Tether USD'
  decimals VARCHAR  -- Amended decimals: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value. Examples: '18', '9'
);

  receipt_effective_gas_price BIGINT,  -- The actual value per gas deducted from the senders account. Replacement of gas_price after EIP-1559. Examples: '125000000', '80000000'
  receipt_contract_address VARCHAR,  -- The contract address created, if the transaction was a contract creation, otherwise null. Examples: '0x00ab09a1db4b8e3e420f0c9fc6b1e8ff02585385', '0x00e8c4b21fd80d2abc8fc33f14f003102ea56717'
  max_fee_per_blob_gas BIGINT,  -- The maximum fee a user is willing to pay per blob gas. Examples: '1000000000', '1650000000'
  receipt_blob_gas_price BIGINT,  -- Blob gas price. Examples: '4286447', '2549026'
  receipt_blob_gas_used BIGINT,  -- Blob gas used. Examples: '393216', '131072'
  blob_count BIGINT,  -- Number of blob versioned hashes of the transaction (length of BigQuery's blob_versioned_hashes). Examples: '0', '3'
  block_number BIGINT,  -- Block number where this transaction was in. Examples: '25879306', '25879019'
  block_timestamp TIMESTAMP  -- Timestamp of the block where this transaction was in. Examples: '2026-09-01 02:00:59', '2026-09-01 01:03:35'
);

-- Every decoded ERC-20/ERC-721 Transfer event of September 2026 (UTC).
CREATE TABLE token_transfers (
  transaction_hash VARCHAR,  -- Transaction hash. Examples: '0x9ddd00c7201a1a4b237d8ed16367ac8b3a54b69c622ea4c3aeb2644316e1fa59', '0xe0e98bbea5ec897217950510ad2935cc3ebf4c10efa4f0d687435562f569aec0'
  log_index BIGINT,  -- Log index in the transaction receipt. Examples: '1', '0'
  token_address VARCHAR,  -- ERC20 token address. Examples: '0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7', '0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48'
  from_address VARCHAR,  -- Address of the sender. Examples: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', '0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90'
  to_address VARCHAR,  -- Address of the receiver. Examples: '0x28c6c06298d514db089934071355e5743bf21d60', '0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90'
  value VARCHAR,  -- Amount of tokens transferred (ERC20) / id of the token transferred (ERC721). Use safe_cast for casting to NUMERIC or FLOAT64. Examples: '0', '1'
  block_number BIGINT,  -- Block number where this transfer was in. Examples: '25879071', '25879095'
  block_timestamp TIMESTAMP  -- Timestamp of the block where this transfer was in. Examples: '2026-09-01 01:13:59', '2026-09-01 01:18:47'
);

-- Contracts that September 2026 touched (called, created, or emitting token transfers); one row per deployment.
CREATE TABLE contracts (
  address VARCHAR,  -- Address of the contract. Examples: '0x60bdee2ee93d117cbf1260fb50adaf906ef15778', '0x747d2c5ead32441946b6e2e3bf971c065ab32904'
  is_erc20 BOOLEAN,  -- Whether this contract is an ERC20 contract. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  is_erc721 BOOLEAN,  -- Whether this contract is an ERC721 contract. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  block_number BIGINT,  -- Block number where this contract was created. Examples: '22027705', '22027709'
  block_timestamp TIMESTAMP  -- Timestamp of the block where this contract was created. Examples: '2025-03-12 02:08:59', '2025-03-12 02:09:47'
);

-- Metadata of every token with a transfer in September 2026, as of the extraction (tokens_latest).
CREATE TABLE tokens (
  address VARCHAR,  -- The token contract address. Examples: '0x000000000000003607fce1ac9e043a86675c5c2f', '0x000000000000012def132e61759048be5b5c6033'
  symbol VARCHAR,  -- The symbol the contract reported when last probed. Examples: 'UNI-V2', 'USDT'
  name VARCHAR,  -- The name the contract reported when last probed. Examples: 'Uniswap V2', 'Tether USD'
  decimals VARCHAR,  -- Decimals as reported, as a string. Use safe_cast for casting to NUMERIC or FLOAT64. Examples: '18', '9'
  decimals_int BIGINT,  -- Decimals as an integer where the reported value is a sane decimal, else NULL. Examples: '18', '9'
  total_supply VARCHAR,  -- The freshest known total supply: the latest reading when it is at least as recent as the metadata probe, else the probe's own value. NULL by design for pure ERC-1155 contracts. Examples: '1000000000000000000000000000', '1000000000000000000'
  token_standard VARCHAR,  -- The most specific standard the contract satisfies: ERC1155, ERC721 or ERC20. Examples: 'ERC20', 'ERC721'
  token_standards VARCHAR,  -- Token standards the contract implements, joined with '|' (an ARRAY in BigQuery). Examples: 'ERC20', 'ERC721'
  protocols VARCHAR,  -- Protocols the token supports, joined with '|' (an ARRAY in BigQuery). Examples: 'erc20', 'erc721'
  is_erc20 BOOLEAN,  -- The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-20 selector predicate. Examples: 'true', 'false'
  is_erc721 BOOLEAN,  -- The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-721 selector predicate. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  is_erc1155 BOOLEAN,  -- The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-1155 selector predicate. Examples: 'false', 'true'
  implementation_address VARCHAR,  -- For proxies, the implementation the contract delegates to. Examples: '0x09a26fc8fcef18192e267d7a6da9dfb4be81dd6a', '0x8b72b9b8e544f944cdcdf0cdb6194f917ac1eba5'
  proxy_standard VARCHAR,  -- How implementation_address was determined: eip1167 or eip1967. Examples: 'eip1167', 'eip1967'
  creator_address VARCHAR,  -- The address that deployed the contract. Examples: '0x5c69bee701ef814a2b6a3edd4b1652cb9cc5aa6f', '0xc6b080ded03c3382476a76345e79f82bd480977b'
  creation_transaction_hash VARCHAR,  -- Hash of the transaction that deployed the contract. Examples: '0xff15954e76ad89528ce3b4d6350bddd9066dbde9f76b597e677b6e1e545d877d', '0xcd8db43e7e923007d0ff2b666560b6fc538aa9d4d9b372bd50bb15f9accf9985'
  block_number BIGINT,  -- Block number where this token was created. Examples: '25972783', '25972656'
  block_timestamp TIMESTAMP  -- Timestamp of the block where this token was created. Examples: '2026-09-14 02:44:59', '2026-09-14 02:19:35'
);

-- Hand-corrected symbol, name and decimals of tokens.
CREATE TABLE amended_tokens (
  address VARCHAR,  -- Lowercase token contract address. Examples: '0x000000000000003607fce1ac9e043a86675c5c2f', '0x000000000000012def132e61759048be5b5c6033'
  symbol VARCHAR,  -- Amended symbol: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value. Examples: 'UNI-V2', 'USDT'
  name VARCHAR,  -- Amended name: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value. Examples: 'Uniswap V2', 'Tether USD'
  decimals VARCHAR  -- Amended decimals: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value. Examples: '18', '9'
);
